newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside says Cossack repair work over.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside says Cossack repair work over.

text.p: Repairs have been completed at the Cossack-Pioneer oil platform offshore Western Australia, with production expected to resume at normal levels of around 90,000 barrels a day by the weekend, a spokesman for operator Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Friday.
"We were producing at around 80,000 barrels on Thursday and expect to be back to our normal level of 90,000 barrels (per day) over the weekend," Woodside spokesman Graeme Atherton said.
The field had been operating at around 40,000 to 45,000 bpd since early May.
Woodside has been forced to shut down Cossack's gas export system due to the failure of a heat exchanger.
"Repairs went smoothly and were completed this week," Atherton said.
